facts.text: John and Max went camping last summer, during which they hiked, swam, and made great memories.

evidence.quote: Max and I had a blast on our camping trip last summer. We hiked, swam, and made great memories.

facts.text: John described the camping trip as a peaceful and awesome experience that allowed him to tune out and get lost in nature.

evidence.quote: It was a really peaceful and awesome experience.
I can imagine that it felt good to tune out and get lost in nature!

facts.text: John mentioned that the camping trip helped him remember the little things in life and savor peaceful moments.

evidence.quote: It made me remember the little things in life and savor the peaceful moments.

facts.text: John expressed that the camping trip was a break from the everyday hustle and bustle, allowing him to restart his mind and spirit.

evidence.quote: Being out in nature, away from all the noise and taking some quality time was great. It was a nice break from the everyday hustle and bustle.
It was like restarting my mind and spirit.
